question: For layer-by-layer urea crystals with the first layer crystallized at 300 °C, what mean crystal masses were obtained with the second layer heated at 250 °C and at 300 °C?
rendered:
According to the document, for single-layer standard group 1 (thickness 0.2 mm), the mean crystal masses were calculated as follows:

- Temp 100 °C 150 °C 200 °C 250 °C 300 °C 350 °C 400 °C
